title.zh-CN: Ticket to Ride：牌凑齐了，为什么路还不一定修得成？
title.en: Ticket to Ride: Why Can a Complete Hand Still Leave You Without a Route?

summary.zh-CN: 用真实地图上的三组局面，拆开双线容量、万能牌的取得方式，以及最后一回合中线路分与车票负分的关系；对照作者的开发回忆。
summary.en: Three worked positions on the original map separate double-route capacity, locomotive acquisition, and final-turn route and ticket scoring, alongside the designer’s development account.

sources.label: Days of Wonder — Ticket to Ride 2015 English rules
sources.edition: Original USA base game, 2015 English reprint; 30 tickets, initial deal three/keep at least two; all expansion and 2025 V2 rules excluded
sources.locator: PDF/printed p.2 components (Chicago–New Orleans 7 illustration), setup and one action per turn; pp.2–3 original map; p.3 drawing, locomotives, claiming and double-route restrictions; p.4 route scoring, ticket scoring, end trigger and longest path

sources.label: Days of Wonder — Ticket to Ride official product page
sources.edition: Current official product page accessed 2026-09-10; used for author identity and old/new rule links only
sources.locator: Author(s): Alan R. Moon; The Rules and Old Rules downloads. Current 33-ticket components and 2025 V2 initial four-ticket deal are not imported into this case.

sources.label: Alan R. Moon & Mark Kaufmann — The History of Ticket To Ride
sources.edition: Game Trade Magazine, April 2014, publicly accessible sample; original-game development retrospective accompanying anniversary promotion
sources.locator: Sample PDF pp.5–6, printed pp.6–7: author byline, Alan’s Story (outline/map, self-test, friend testing, later route/rule/ticket changes); Kaufmann’s separately attributed setting/title account. Anniversary advertisement is not rules evidence.

title.zh-CN: 角度一：同一张地图，实际容量会随人数变化

title.en: Angle two: A wildcard’s price includes how and when you acquire it

title.en: Angle three: A final turn turns a seven-point ticket into a fourteen-point swing
